scope: R3 / UNINST-01 item 349: import a previously exported manifest and diff it against this machine, replacing a manifest that could only be written
status: implemented-and-isolated-verified; no real user environment touched
gapClosed: Item 349 asked for export, import, backup and recovery. Only export existed: EnvironmentManifest was Serialize-only, the notes told the reader 导入不会自动执行, and there was no way to read a manifest back. A user holding a manifest from last month could not answer the only question it can honestly support: what changed here since then.
whyImportIsAComparison: A manifest records absolute paths on one machine and carries no file content, so turning it into restored environments would require inventing where the bytes come from. Import is therefore a read-only diff. It is the half of item 349 that can be implemented without a restore design, and it makes the existing export genuinely useful instead of write-only.

implementation.serde: EnvironmentManifest and ManifestEntry gained Deserialize alongside Serialize, with PartialEq so round-trips and comparisons are testable.
implementation.compare_manifests: Pure function over two already-built manifests: no filesystem, no clock, so every classification rule is reachable from a fixture instead of only through IPC.
implementation.pairing: Entries pair on (env type, lowercased name) through a BTreeMap on both sides, so a moved or renamed entry surfaces as missing+added rather than being silently matched to a neighbour.
implementation.classification: Each pair lands in exactly one of unchanged / added / missing / changed. An added row leaves the recorded side null and a missing row leaves the current side null, so neither reads as an empty version string.
implementation.pathComparison: Paths go through detect::system::path_key, so case, separator direction and a trailing separator do not produce phantom 路径 differences.
implementation.nullVersion: A recorded null version means the probe failed at export time, not that the version is empty, so it never triggers a 版本 difference. This is the distinction most likely to be implemented wrongly.
implementation.rootMismatch: same_root is false when the roots differ or the manifest has none, and only then does the cross-machine limitation appear: row results then describe a diff, not a defect.
implementation.sourceGuard: validate_manifest_source rejects relative paths, non-.json extensions, a missing file and a directory before parsing; schema_version is checked separately so a future manifest fails loudly instead of mis-parsing.
implementation.noRestore: The command returns a comparison and nothing else. There is no restore path, no environment creation and no mutation of the managed root.

fixtures.name: commands::tests::manifest_comparison_classifies_unchanged_added_missing_and_changed
asserts: a path differing only in case, separator and trailing slash is Unchanged with no differences
a version change reports exactly [版本]
a status change reports exactly [状态]
a recorded null version does not mark the entry changed even when a version is now known
an added row has null recorded side rather than echoing current values
a manifest recorded under another root sets same_root=false and states the cross-machine limitation
the same-root comparison does not carry that limitation
an entry present on both sides under different roots is Changed with [路径], not Missing (this assertion failed against my first implementation and corrected my own expectation)

relative paths, non-json extensions, absent files and a directory are all rejected
a manifest entry absent locally becomes Missing with its recorded version kept
the missing row leaves the current side null rather than a blank string

notVerified: No real manifest from another machine was imported; every comparison used fixtures
The UI path never wrote a real file: the picker and the command are both mocked
Restore/recovery remains unimplemented, so item 349's 备份和恢复 half is untouched
limitations: Pairing is by (type, lowercased name). Two genuinely different installations that share a name are reported as one entry; the limitation text says so rather than the code pretending otherwise
Cross-machine comparisons flag 路径 differences for every entry, which is honest but noisy; there is no path mapping UI
A manifest whose schema_version is not 1 is refused outright; no migration path exists yet
Item 349 stays unchecked: export+import are done, backup/recovery are not
